# - <VARIABLE>: Specifies the span of the variable.

node.criteria: Pass if a recognizable frog is visibly within the bowl opening/interior; fail if the bowl is assessable and no frog is within it, even if frogs appear elsewhere; unknown if the relevant placement cannot be assessed reliably.
